premises.text: Many smartphone users lack internet access, creating life-critical and development connectivity gaps
premises.evidence_span: 66% of the world has a smartphone in their hands, but 53% of the population does not have access to internet

premises.text: An SDK lets existing apps work offline instead of building a new consumer app
premises.evidence_span: Ridgefire is an SDK that apps integrate onto their own code so they can work offline

premises.text: Bluetooth mesh networking hops messages across devices to extend range beyond a single 330-foot link
premises.evidence_span: it creates mesh networks, which means that information can hop on devices found in the middle, so the range is increased

premises.text: Smart mesh algorithm limits flooding, message lifetime, and battery drain; stack is encrypted, patented, and Android-iOS
premises.evidence_span: We are the only ones in the market with Android to iOS integration. We are encrypted, and we're patented

premises.text: B2B go-to-market sells to developers who already have user density
premises.evidence_span: we're working on a B2B model. We cater to developers that already have this user density

premises.text: Pricing charges on monthly active users that use the app thanks to Bridgefy technology
premises.evidence_span: We charge based on monthly active users that use your app thanks to our technology each month

value.text: Apps keep working and connecting people without internet, including emergencies
value.evidence_span: imagine being able to use WhatsApp or Uber or Snapchat when you don't have access to internet

secondary_value.text: Emergency and community connectivity that can save lives
secondary_value.evidence_span: improve and save people's lives and hopefully connect full communities and cities

causal_links.evidence_span: It can be the difference between life and death
apps integrate onto their own code so they can work offline
when developers make this revenue, we also make it
